title: Can AI Agents Help Robotic Engineers? Lessons from Two Focus Days in Industry
title_zh: 人工智能智能体能帮助机器人工程师吗？来自行业两次焦点日活动的经验教训

paragraphs.en: Software developers increasingly use AI agents that execute multi-step programming tasks on their own. However, it is unclear if and how this transfers to robotic engineering, where engineers program industrial robots in niche, vendor-specific languages and rely on visual feedback from simulation tools. Within this paper, we report a case study on the use of AI agents by an SME that programs industrial robots. Our results show that the agent did not make the engineers more productive, with the exception of a task that required the generation of highly repetitive code. However, the results with the agent improved over time, as the engineers learned how to use it and the agent was adapted to the domain. Moreover, the experience with AI mattered more for the success with the agent than the experience with robotic engineering. This shows that AI agents are not a plug-and-play solution. Instead, companies must train their engineers on the usage of agents, plan time for a learning curve, and ensure that agent configurations match the domain and developer requirements. The strong learning curve we observed further implies that studies on productivity gains with AI should be longitudinal, as they otherwise miss how engineers adopt agents in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 软件开发者越来越多地使用能够自主执行多步骤编程任务的AI智能体。 然而，尚不清楚这是否以及如何迁移到机器人工程领域——在该领域中，工程师使用小众的、厂商专有的语言对工业机器人进行编程，并依赖仿真工具提供的视觉反馈。 本文报告了一项关于一家工业机器人编程中小企业使用AI智能体的案例研究。 我们的结果表明，该智能体并未提升工程师的生产效率，唯一例外是一项需要生成高度重复代码的任务。 然而，使用该智能体的效果随时间推移而改善，这既得益于工程师学会了如何使用它，也得益于智能体被适配到该领域。 此外，相较于机器人工程方面的经验，AI使用经验对成功使用智能体的作用更大。 这表明AI智能体并非即插即用的解决方案。 相反，企业必须就智能体的使用对工程师进行培训，为学习曲线预留时间，并确保智能体的配置与领域及开发者需求相匹配。 我们观察到的陡峭学习曲线进一步表明，关于AI生产力提升的研究应采用纵向研究方法，否则就会遗漏工程师在实践中如何采纳智能体的过程。

paragraphs.en: Programming of industrial robots is a specialized sub-domain at the intersection of software development and industrial engineering: engineers write code in vendor-specific languages like ABB RAPID and check the movements of the robot visually in simulation tools like RobotStudio [ 1 ] . Projects often differ from typical software development in multiple aspects, e.g., due to the use of visual programming and because solutions are typically adapted from previous programs rather than re-written from scratch. Thus, repetitive and error-prone tasks like renaming, shifting positions, or reversing paths are common [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 工业机器人的编程是软件开发与工业工程交叉领域的一个专门子领域：工程师使用 ABB RAPID 等厂商专用语言编写代码，并在 RobotStudio 等仿真工具中直观地检查机器人的运动 [ 1 ] 。 此类项目往往在多个方面与典型的软件开发有所不同，例如，由于使用了可视化编程，并且解决方案通常是在先前程序的基础上改编而来，而不是从头重写。 因此，诸如重命名、移动位置或反转路径等重复性且容易出错的任务十分常见 [ 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, software developers increasingly use AI agents that execute multi-step tasks on their own, instead of only completing code or answering questions in a chat [ 13 ] . However, the evidence on the productivity effects of such tools is inconclusive [ 12 , 19 , 8 ] and comes from mainstream software development. It is unclear if and how it transfers to robotic engineering. Work on Large Language Models (LLMs) for industrial automation evaluates the AI solutions in isolation, i.e., without engineers in the loop [ 9 , 10 ] . To the best of our knowledge, there is no empirical evidence on whether agents help robotic engineers in industry with the range of their daily tasks, i.e., beyond isolated code changes. Similarly, we do not know how these engineers use agents and which problems they face when adopting them.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，软件开发者越来越多地使用能够自主执行多步骤任务的智能体，而不仅仅是在聊天中完成代码或回答问题 [ 13 ] 。 然而，此类工具对生产力影响的证据尚无定论 [ 12 , 19 , 8 ] ，且这些证据来自主流软件开发领域。 目前尚不清楚这些结论能否迁移到机器人工程中，以及如何迁移。 面向工业自动化的大语言模型（LLM）相关研究在孤立地评估 AI 解决方案，即评估过程中没有工程师参与 [ 9 , 10 ] 。 据我们所知，目前尚无实证证据表明智能体能否帮助工业界的机器人工程师完成其各类日常任务，即超越孤立的代码修改。 同样，我们也不知道这些工程师如何使用智能体，以及在采用智能体时会遇到哪些问题。

paragraphs.en: How does using agentic AI affect the completion, time, and quality of robotic engineering tasks compared to working without AI?
paragraphs.zh: 与不使用 AI 相比，使用智能体式 AI 对机器人工程任务的完成度、耗时和质量有何影响？

paragraphs.en: How do engineers that are specialized in the programming of industrial robots use agentic AI and which problems do they face when adopting this new technology?
paragraphs.zh: 专门从事工业机器人编程的工程师如何使用智能体式 AI（agentic AI），他们在采用这项新技术时面临哪些问题？

paragraphs.en: Our results indicate that the agent did not help the developers to solve tasks faster or with better functionality than without AI. The only exception is the generation of highly repetitive code. However, the solutions with the agent improved between the focus days, especially regarding the adherence to AKE’s programming standards. We believe that this is due to both the learning curve of the developers and our re-design of the agent between the focus days, i.e., the configuration of the agent must also fit this setting. Regarding the usage, we found that the developers delegated all work to the agent, including trivial changes, used it like a chatbot instead of invoking the skills we prepared, and missed the visual feedback from the virtual station. Moreover, the experience with AI mattered more for the successful use of the agent than the experience with robotic engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果表明，智能体并没有帮助开发者比不使用 AI 时更快地解决任务，也没有带来更好的功能。 唯一的例外是生成高度重复的代码。 然而，使用智能体的解决方案在焦点日之间有所改进，尤其是在遵循 AKE 的编程规范方面。 我们认为这是由于开发者的学习曲线以及我们在焦点日之间对智能体的重新设计所致，也就是说，智能体的配置也必须符合这一环境。 在使用方式上，我们发现开发者将所有工作都委派给智能体，包括琐碎的修改，把它当作聊天机器人来使用，而不是调用我们准备的技能，并且怀念虚拟工位提供的视觉反馈。 此外，对于智能体的成功使用而言，AI 经验比机器人工程经验更为重要。

paragraphs.en: Based on these findings, we derive the following lessons for practitioners:
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些发现，我们为从业者总结出以下经验教训：

paragraphs.en: An on-premise agent with an open-weight model is technically feasible for SMEs with confidential data. However, it is not a plug-and-play solution that directly increases productivity.
paragraphs.zh: 对于拥有机密数据的中小企业而言，部署本地智能体并搭配开放权重模型在技术上是可行的。 然而，它并不是一个即插即用、能直接提升生产力的解决方案。

sents.en: An on-premise agent with an open-weight model is technically feasible for SMEs with confidential data.

paragraphs.en: Experienced robotic engineers are not automatically experienced users of agents. Thus, SMEs should train the usage of agents, e.g., when to delegate and when to change code manually, and plan time for a learning curve.
paragraphs.zh: 经验丰富的机器人工程师并不自动就是经验丰富的智能体使用者。 因此，中小企业应培训智能体的使用方法，例如何时委派给智能体、何时手动修改代码，并为学习曲线规划时间。

paragraphs.en: Repetitive and well-specified tasks, e.g., the generation of trajectories, are a better starting point than tasks that require a spatial understanding of the robot cell.
paragraphs.zh: 重复且定义明确的任务，例如轨迹的生成，比需要对机器人单元进行空间理解的任务是更好的起点。

paragraphs.en: Domain knowledge like reference manuals and programming standards should be available to the agent automatically, instead of relying on the developers to request it.
paragraphs.zh: 像参考手册和编程规范这类领域知识应当自动提供给智能体，而不是依赖开发者主动请求。

paragraphs.en: Recent research has increasingly examined the effects of AI and LLMs workers’ productivity including coding [ 7 ] , customer support [ 4 ] , law [ 6 ] and many other fields. Most existing estimates focus on earlier-generation tools, such as autocomplete systems and chatbots, while developers increasingly adopt agentic tools [ 13 ] . Evidence on the productivity effects of these newer tools remains limited and inconclusive [ 8 ] . Becker et al. [ 12 ] find that AI coding tools reduce the productivity of experienced developers, whereas other studies document substantial gains [ 19 ] . Chen et al. [ 5 ] show that AI tools increase coding activity within enterprises, although these increases translate only partially into greater output. Similarly, Demirer et al. [ 8 ] demonstrate that successive generations of AI coding tools generate progressively larger productivity gains at the task level, with diminishing returns for more complex or higher-level tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究越来越多地考察 AI 和 LLM 对工作者生产率的影响，涉及编程 [ 7 ] 、客户支持 [ 4 ] 、法律 [ 6 ] 等诸多领域。 大多数现有估计聚焦于早期一代的工具，如自动补全系统和聊天机器人，而开发者正日益采用智能体式工具 [ 13 ] 。 关于这些较新工具的生产率效应的证据仍然有限且尚无定论 [ 8 ] 。Becker 等人 [ 12 ] 发现 AI 编程工具会降低有经验开发者的生产率，而其他研究则记录了可观的收益 [ 19 ] 。Chen 等人 [ 5 ] 表明 AI 工具提高了企业内部的编程活动，但这些增长仅有部分转化为更大的产出。 类似地，Demirer 等人 [ 8 ] 证明一代接一代的 AI 编程工具在任务层面产生了逐步增大的生产率收益，而对更复杂或更高层次的任务则呈现收益递减。

paragraphs.en: In specialized industrial control and manufacturing environments, achieving verifiable code and reducing commissioning time are critical determinants of productivity. Fakih et al. [ 9 ] address this by introducing LLM4PLC, an agentic pipeline for industrial control programming that pairs generative models with external compilers, grammar checkers, and model verifiers. By offloading error detection and logic repair to an automated iterative agent loop, their approach increases compilation pass rates from 47% to 72% and drastically reduces engineering iteration cycles. However, this work was only conducted using the FischerTechnik Manufacturing TestBed, i.e., never validated in a real-life industrial setting.
paragraphs.zh: 在专业的工业控制与制造环境中，实现可验证的代码并缩短调试时间是决定生产率的关键因素。Fakih 等人 [9] 通过提出 LLM4PLC 来应对这一挑战，这是一个用于工业控制编程的智能体流水线，将生成式模型与外部编译器、语法检查器和模型验证器相结合。 通过将错误检测与逻辑修复交给自动化的迭代智能体循环来处理，他们的方法将编译通过率从 47% 提升至 72%，并大幅缩短了工程迭代周期。 然而，这项工作仅在 FischerTechnik 制造测试平台上进行了实验，即从未在真实工业场景中得到验证。

paragraphs.en: In a complementary domain-specific application, Patel [ 16 ] proposes an agentic AI framework for self-healing production lines with robotics, enabling autonomous fault diagnosis and correction in real time. His findings indicate a substantial decrease in downtime, with incidents often being resolved more than 80% faster, and defects are almost entirely prevented from spreading to subsequent stages of production. This shows the potential of agentic systems for maintenance tasks, but does not look at the programming of new components.

paragraphs.en: In our previous research [ 10 ] we explored the capabilities of a general-purpose LLM in the industrial robotic manufacturing process through prompt engineering. We showed that an SME can utilize Llama 3.1 70B [ 11 ] to solve simple but recurring problems in ABB’s RAPID through prompt engineering without the need for expensive solutions like training their own model. However, this work was limited to three controlled problems and evaluated on historic data.

paragraphs.en: We study the use of AI agents in a real industrial context, i.e., with real engineers, real tasks, and real constraints. This allows us to observe how agents perform in practice and how industrial engineers that are programming robotic software use them in their daily work. Methodologically, our work is therefore a case study in the sense of Wohlin et al. [ 22 ] , i.e., we study a small sample of engineers and tasks in depth within their real working environment and we do not aim for statistical generalization. Instead, we want to collect rich quantitative and qualitative evidence on how the agent performs and how the engineers use it in this industrial context.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在真实的工业环境中研究 AI 智能体的使用，即与真实的工程师、真实的任务和真实的约束条件打交道。 这使我们能够观察智能体在实际中的表现，以及编写机器人软件的工业工程师在日常工作中如何使用它们。 因此，在方法论上，我们的工作是按照 Wohlin 等人意义上的案例研究进行的。 [ 22 ]，即我们在真实的工作环境中对小样本的工程师和任务进行深入研究，并不追求统计上的泛化。 相反，我们希望收集丰富的定量和定性证据，以了解智能体在这一工业环境中的表现以及工程师如何使用它。

paragraphs.en: We conducted our case study together with AKE Technologies, an SME that develops robotic automation solutions for the manufacturing processes of their customers. The robotic engineers at AKE program ABB robots in ABB RAPID. They develop and test their programs in virtual stations in RobotStudio [ 1 ] , i.e., ABB’s environment for simulation and offline programming, before they deploy them to the real robots at the customer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们与AKE Technologies合作开展了案例研究，该公司是一家中小型企业，为其客户的制造流程开发机器人自动化解决方案。 AKE的机器人工程师使用ABB RAPID对ABB机器人进行编程。 他们先在RobotStudio [ 1 ]（即ABB的仿真与离线编程环境）中的虚拟工作站中开发和测试程序，然后才将其部署到客户现场的真实机器人上。

paragraphs.en: Two constraints at AKE restrict how AI can be used. First, the code and data of customers are confidential and the use of cloud-based LLMs is not allowed. A local server with a single H100 GPU is available for inference. Second, AKE does not have the resources to develop or train a custom solution, i.e., any solution should be easy to maintain and rely on public models and agent harnesses. We believe that this setting is representative for many SMEs that consider adopting AI agents in confidential contexts with a limited budget.
paragraphs.zh: AKE 的两条限制约束了 AI 的使用方式。 首先，客户的代码和数据是保密的，不允许使用基于云端的 LLM。 有一台配备单块 H100 GPU 的本地服务器可用于推理。 其次，AKE 没有资源去开发或训练定制方案，即任何方案都应易于维护，并依赖公开的模型和智能体框架。 我们认为，这一场景对许多希望在预算有限的保密环境中采用 AI 智能体的中小企业具有代表性。

paragraphs.en: The case study was conducted with the group of robotics programming at AKE. The team lead and head of robotic programming served as our primary point of contact. He was also responsible to ensure that everything is embedded realistically in the development processes and defined the tasks for which we conducted direct measurements (Section III-B ) and assessed the functional and non-functional quality of the solutions, according to AKE’s standards (Section III-F ). The four developers working in the team solved tasks with and without the use of AI (Section III-D ).

paragraphs.en: Our role as researchers was to provide and monitor the AI solution and define the scientific instruments of the case study, i.e., criteria to assess the solutions, the questionnaires, and the workflow of the focus days. We note that we did not have any influence on the tasks or their assessment, which was done by the team lead according to AKE’s standards.
paragraphs.zh: 我们作为研究人员的角色是提供并监控该人工智能解决方案，以及定义案例研究的科学工具，即用于评估解决方案的标准、问卷以及聚焦日的工作流程。 我们指出，我们对这些任务或其评估没有任何影响，评估是由团队负责人按照 AKE 的标准进行的。

paragraphs.en: For this case study, we extended the use cases from our prior work with AKE [ 10 ] such that they cover the range of tasks that engineers encounter in their daily work, i.e., refactoring and extension of existing programs, documentation, debugging, path inversion, trajectory generation, and 3D stacking (Sections III-B1 – III-B6 ). For each of these activities, the team lead defined concrete tasks from actual project contexts as study objects for us (Section III-A ). The developers were given natural language descriptions of the tasks that followed AKE’s style guides and conventions in exactly the same manner as real projects, i.e., while we focused on specific tasks, the actual tasks occur as is in the daily development. The task descriptions were in German, which is the mother tongue of all developers. All tasks are non-trivial activities, for which the estimated effort is between 30 and 60 minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 在本案例研究中，我们扩展了先前工作中与 AKE [10] 一起使用的用例，使其涵盖工程师在日常工作中遇到的各种任务，即重构与扩展现有程序、编写文档、调试、路径求逆、轨迹生成以及三维堆叠（第 III-B1 – III-B6 节）。 针对上述每项活动，团队负责人从实际项目背景中定义了具体任务，作为我们的研究对象（第 III-A 节）。 开发者收到的是以自然语言描述的任务，这些任务遵循 AKE 的风格指南和约定，与真实项目完全一致，也就是说，虽然我们聚焦于特定任务，但这些任务是原封不动地来自日常开发中的真实任务。 任务描述使用德语，这是所有开发者的母语。 所有任务都是非平凡的活动，估计工作量在 30 到 60 分钟之间。

paragraphs.en: Overall, we defined six tasks. Tasks 1, 4, and 6 are related to the use cases from our prior work [ 10 ] , i.e., the renaming of arguments as key activity of refactoring projects (Task 1), the reversal of movements (Task 4), and working with offsets of positions (Task 6). For these tasks, we already know that a general-purpose LLM can perform them through prompt engineering, and these tasks allow us to generalize the findings from individual changes to larger operations in real-life contexts guided by a human developer. The other three tasks were not part of our prior work, i.e., the generation of documentation for code (Task 2), the identification of mistakes (Task 3), and the creation of new movement trajectories (Task 5). In general, the new tasks require similar skills as the existing tasks. However, they focus more on the creation of new information, i.e., documents, finding unknown errors, and new trajectories, than on the modification of existing code.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们定义了六个任务。 任务 1、4 和 6 与我们先前工作 [ 10 ] 中的用例相关，即参数重命名作为重构项目的关键活动（任务 1）、移动的撤销（任务 4），以及处理位置的偏移量（任务 6）。 对于这些任务，我们已经知道通用的 LLM 可以通过提示工程来完成它们，并且这些任务使我们能够在人类开发者的引导下，将针对单个变更的发现推广到真实场景中的更大规模操作。 其余三个任务不属于我们先前的工作，即为代码生成文档（任务 2）、识别错误（任务 3），以及创建新的移动轨迹（任务 5）。 总的来说，新任务需要与现有任务类似的技能。 然而，它们更侧重于新信息的创建，即文档、发现未知错误以及新轨迹，而不是对现有代码的修改。

paragraphs.en: The engineers extend an existing program with new code that is almost identical to code that already exists, i.e., they copy existing routines, apply small changes, e.g., the renaming of variables, and call the new routines at the correct positions in the program. This is one of the most common tasks at AKE: most projects build on code from previously finished projects due to the similarity between production lines. While each individual change is simple, the challenge is to make all changes consistently and to integrate the new code correctly into the existing program flow.
paragraphs.zh: 工程师们在现有程序中扩展一些与已有代码几乎完全相同的新代码，即他们复制现有的例程，进行少量修改，例如重命名变量，然后在程序中的正确位置调用新例程。 这是 AKE 中最常见的任务之一：由于生产线之间的相似性，大多数项目都基于之前已完成项目的代码构建。 虽然每项单独的修改都很简单，但挑战在于一致地完成所有修改，并将新代码正确地集成到现有程序流程中。

paragraphs.en: The engineers write external textual documentation of a robotic program that follows AKE’s standards. Concretely, they fill a template provided by AKE that requires system metadata (e.g., the project name, the robot type), all defined coordinate systems and robotic tools, a description of the workflow of the program, and a list of all movement routines with a short description of their purpose. paragraphs.en: Debugging is a very common task in any development process. The errors were induced by the team lead based on common error patterns that the engineers encounter.

paragraphs.en: The engineers are only given the coordinates of multiple positions. They must create the complete movement paths between these positions, i.e., two movement routines (forward and backward) between each pair of positions from scratch, without without existing code to start from. This is common for situations where a completely new component is introduced into a production line. While each individual routine is relatively simple, the number of routines grows quickly with the number of positions. Thus, the task is repetitive and prone to small mistakes.

paragraphs.en: The engineers must program the robot to stack batteries on top of each other. The movements are repetitive, but with different offsets for the pick-up and place-down positions of each battery. The team lead reported this task as the most difficult of our tasks, because it requires a mathematical computation of the movements’ offset and planning an efficient movement order to stack the batteries.

paragraphs.en: We use Claude Code [ 3 ] in the terminal as agent, because it provides the agentic loop out of the box, i.e., it can read files, write code, execute shell commands, and check its own changes without the need for custom agent scaffolding. Moreover, Claude Code can be connected to any server with an Anthropic-compatible API. As an LLM, we use GPT-OSS 120B [ 15 ] , which we serve through Ollama [ 21 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在终端中使用 Claude Code [ 3 ] 作为智能体，因为它开箱即用地提供了智能体循环（agentic loop），即它可以读取文件、编写代码、执行 shell 命令并检查自己的修改，而无需自定义的智能体脚手架。 此外，Claude Code 可以通过兼容 Anthropic 的 API 连接到任何服务器。 作为大语言模型，我们使用 GPT-OSS 120B [ 15 ]，并通过 Ollama [ 21 ] 提供服务。

paragraphs.en: Before the focus days, we validated that this setup is capable of solving the tasks in general, i.e., that it generates syntactically correct RAPID code and that it understands the tasks. We did not require that the agent solves the tasks fully autonomously. Instead, it was sufficient that the agent generated reasonable outputs that were on a trajectory towards a correct solution. During this testing period, we also considered other open-weight models, including Qwen3.6 35B [ 18 ] , Gemma4 31B [ 20 ] , GLM-4.7-Flash Q4 [ 23 ] and Laguna XS.2 Q4 [ 17 ] , but we found that GPT-OSS 120B performed best for our tasks. We note that we did not perform a systematic evaluation of different models, because this was not the focus of our case study. Instead, we focused on the interaction between the developers and the agent, which is independent of the specific model.

paragraphs.en: For the first focus day, we provided three skills, which we derived from the use cases of our prior work [ 10 ] : argument-modification renames variables in a movement routine (related to Task 1), offset adds an offset instruction to a movement routine (related to Task 6), and reverse reverses a movement routine (related to Task 4). The developers had to select and invoke the skills themselves whenever they deemed them useful. We note that the tasks were designed such that these skills are frequently required.

paragraphs.en: However, we observed that the developers did not use the skills as intended on the first focus day (Section IV-B ). paragraphs.en: The main part of our case study are two focus days, during which we observed how the developers solved the tasks with and without the agent. On each focus day, AKE gathered the engineers of the robotic programming team, who reserved the full day for working on the tasks. The developers worked on their own machines with their usual tools, e.g., RobotStudio, and their usual development setup. However, instead of working on their usual projects, they solved the tasks we provided. Thus, they more or less had a regular work day with mixed tasks, as can happen whenever there is demand from multiple projects at the same time. This setting gives us some control over what we observe, while the engineers still work in their usual environment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们案例研究的主要部分是两个重点日，在此期间我们观察了开发者如何在有智能体和没有智能体的情况下完成任务。 在每个重点日，AKE 召集了机器人编程团队的工程师，他们预留了整天的时间来处理这些任务。 开发者在自己的机器上使用他们常用的工具（例如 RobotStudio）和常用的开发环境进行工作。 不过，他们并不是处理平时负责的项目，而是完成我们提供的任务。 因此，他们或多或少地度过了一个任务混合的正常工作日，就像多个项目同时提出需求时可能出现的情况一样。 这种设置使我们对观察的内容有了一定的控制，同时工程师们仍然在熟悉的环境中工作。

paragraphs.en: We split the developers into two groups. On the first focus day, Group A worked without AI in the morning and with the agent in the afternoon, while Group B worked with the agent in the morning and without AI in the afternoon. On the second focus day, the groups swapped. This is essentially an AB/BA crossover design, which allows us to reduce the influence of individual differences between the developers. We note, however, that the small number of developers does not allow for statistical generalization.

paragraphs.en: Since each developer works on every type of task on both focus days, i.e., once with the agent and once without AI, we did not use the exact same tasks twice. paragraphs.en: Each focus day started with a short introduction to the agent by the first author, which covered a general description of the agent. On the first focus day, the introduction additionally explained which skills we prepared for the developers and how to use them. On the second focus day, the introduction instead explained how we configured the local project context with the reference manual and the task description, which removes the need for the developers to select skills themselves. Afterwards, the developers worked on the tasks, three in the morning and three in the afternoon, with a lunch break in between. For each developer and task, we collected the time, the answers to the task questionnaire, a backup of the resulting RobotStudio project, and, if the developer used the agent, the chat history with the agent (Sections III-E and III-F ). The tasks were time-boxed, i.e., if developers did not finish a task within the time limit, they had to stop and move on to the next task. The time limits were set by the team lead based on the task complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 每个专注日都以第一作者对智能体的简短介绍开始，内容包括对该智能体的总体描述。 在第一个专注日，介绍还额外说明了我们为开发者准备了哪些技能以及如何使用这些技能。 在第二个专注日，介绍改为说明我们如何利用参考手册和任务描述配置本地项目上下文，从而使开发者无需自行选择技能。 之后，开发者开始完成任务，上午三项、下午三项，中间有午休。 对于每位开发者和每项任务，我们收集了所用时间、任务问卷的回答、最终 RobotStudio 项目的备份，以及（如果开发者使用了智能体）与智能体的聊天记录（第 III-E 和 III-F 节）。 任务采用了限时设置，即如果开发者未能在时限内完成某项任务，就必须停止并进入下一项任务。 时限由团队负责人根据任务复杂度设定。

paragraphs.en: Between the two focus days, there was a break of eight weeks. During this period, we encouraged the developers to use the agent within their daily work however they wanted.
paragraphs.zh: 在两个焦点日之间，间隔了八周。 在此期间，我们鼓励开发人员在日常工作中以他们想要的任何方式使用智能体。

paragraphs.en: As part of our case study, we wanted to understand how the developers perceive the agent, e.g., which problems they encounter and whether their expectations are met. Thus, we defined questionnaires that the developers answered at different points of the focus days (Section III-D ). The questionnaires were written in German and handed out on paper. Unless stated otherwise, the closed questions use a five-point Likert scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree).
paragraphs.zh: 作为案例研究的一部分，我们想了解开发者如何看待智能体，例如他们遇到哪些问题以及他们的期望是否得到满足。 因此，我们设计了问卷，让开发者在焦点日的不同时间点填写（第 III-D 节）。 问卷以德语编写并以纸质形式发放。 除非另有说明，封闭式问题均采用五点李克特量表，从 1（非常不同意）到 5（非常同意）。

sents.zh: 问卷以德语编写并以纸质形式发放。

paragraphs.en: The developers filled the pre-questionnaire once at the beginning of the first focus day. It contains demographic questions, questions about the experience of the developers with AI (self-rated knowledge and frequency of use), and questions about their expectations of the agent. We measure the expectations as agreement with five statements, i.e., that using AI 1) leads to better results, 2) adheres to AKE’s programming standards, 3) speeds up the development, and 4) understands the tasks correctly, as well as 5) that the developer wants to use AI in their work. Additionally, the developers rated whether they expect the agent to be easy to use and the tasks to be difficult with and without AI.
paragraphs.zh: 开发者在第一个专注日开始时填写一次前测问卷。 问卷包含人口统计学问题、关于开发者使用 AI 经验的问题（自评知识和使用频率），以及关于他们对智能体的期望的问题。 我们通过开发者对五项陈述的认同程度来衡量期望，即：使用 AI 1) 能带来更好的结果，2) 符合 AKE 的编程标准，3) 能加快开发速度，4) 能正确理解任务，以及 5) 开发者希望在工作中使用 AI。 此外，开发者还评定了他们是否期望该智能体易于使用，以及在使用和不使用 AI 的情况下任务是否困难。

sents.zh: 开发者在第一个专注日开始时填写一次前测问卷。

paragraphs.en: The developers filled the task questionnaire after each task, i.e., six times per focus day. It asks for the perceived difficulty and realism of the task, the self-reported time spent on thinking about the solution (brainstorming) and on the actual implementation, and the problems the developer faced during the task. On the second focus day, the developers had solved each type of task once with and once without the agent. Therefore, the task questionnaire of the second focus day additionally asks for the agreement that the agent avoided problems of the development without AI and that it led to problems that the development without AI avoided, each with a free-text field for examples.
paragraphs.zh: 开发者在每次任务完成后填写任务问卷，即每个聚焦日填写六次。 问卷询问任务的主观难度与真实性、自报的思考解决方案（头脑风暴）所花时间与实际实现所花时间，以及开发者在任务中遇到的问题。 在第二个聚焦日，开发者已经对每类任务分别在使用智能体和不使用智能体的情况下各完成过一次。 因此，第二个聚焦日的任务问卷还额外询问开发者是否认同智能体避免了不使用 AI 的开发中出现的问题，以及是否认同它导致了不使用 AI 的开发所能避免的问题，每项均配有用于举例的自由文本输入框。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the solutions of the developers with respect to the time they required and the quality of their results. Additionally, we use the questionnaires to understand how the developers perceived and used the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从所需时间和结果质量两个方面评估开发者的解决方案。 在质量方面，我们将团队负责人的手动评估与对 RAPID 代码的自动验证相结合。 此外，我们利用问卷来了解开发者对该智能体的感知和使用方式。

paragraphs.en: After each focus day, the team lead assessed the resulting RobotStudio backups of all developers and tasks. We defined three criteria for this together with the team lead.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个专注日结束后，团队负责人会对所有开发者和任务的 RobotStudio 备份结果进行评估。 我们与团队负责人共同为此定义了三个标准。

sents.en: We defined three criteria for this together with the team lead.
sents.zh: 我们与团队负责人共同为此定义了三个标准。

paragraphs.en: The functionality , i.e., whether the solution fulfills the requirements of the task and the robot behaves correctly in the virtual station.
paragraphs.zh: 功能，即解决方案是否满足任务要求，且机器人在虚拟车站中表现正确。

paragraphs.en: The code quality , i.e., whether the code adheres to AKE’s programming standards.
paragraphs.zh: 代码质量，即代码是否符合 AKE 的编程规范。

paragraphs.en: The readability , i.e., whether other engineers at AKE can easily understand the code, e.g., through naming and comments.
paragraphs.zh: 可读性，即 AKE 的其他工程师能否轻松理解代码，例如通过命名和注释。

paragraphs.en: The team lead rated each criterion on a scale from 1 (Criterion not met) to 5 (Criterion exceeds expectations significantly) relative to the expectations of AKE for a solution of an experienced engineer. We note that the assessment was not blind, i.e., the team lead knew which solutions were created with the agent and which without AI. For the debugging task (Task 3), these criteria are not meaningful, because the developers modify existing code instead of creating new code. Instead, the team lead counted how many of the eight injected errors the developers fixed and how many remained, separately for the two syntax errors and the six semantic errors.

paragraphs.en: Before the first focus day, the developers were open towards the agent (Figure 1 ). They wanted to use AI agents for robotic projects (mean 4.5) and rather expected that the agent speeds up the development (3.5) and understands the tasks correctly (3.25). paragraphs.en: Table I shows that the agent did not help the developers to solve the tasks faster on the first focus day. With the agent, the developers finished only 3 of 12 tasks within the time limit, i.e., D2 the debugging task (Task 3) and D1 and D3 the trajectory matrix generation (Task 5). The difference is largest for Tasks 1 and 4: both developers with the agent hit the time limit, while the developers without AI finished Task 1 after 38 and 42 of 60 minutes and Task 4 after 14 and 26 of 30 minutes. We note that some tasks were also hard without AI, i.e., nobody finished the documentation task (Task 2) in time and only D2 finished the 3D stacking task (Task 6). Task 5 is the only task that all developers finished.

paragraphs.en: The perception of the developers matches these results. The developers perceived the tasks as slightly more difficult with the agent (mean 2.75) than without AI (2.5). However, this differs between the tasks: with the agent, the developers found Tasks 1 and 3 easier, but Tasks 2 and 4–6 harder than without AI. With the agent, the developers also reported more time for brainstorming (12.8 instead of 8.8 minutes) and for the implementation (24.4 instead of 21.3 minutes) (Figure 2 ). Without AI, the developers mostly reported problems that are typical for their daily work, e.g., adapting code after copy-and-paste (3 mentions), searching for information, and finding errors. With the agent, the most frequent problem was errors of the agent (4 mentions), followed by using the agent and checking its results (2 mentions each). This indicates that the agent replaced the usual problems with new ones, instead of removing them.

paragraphs.en: After the first focus day, the agreement with all statements except the correct understanding of the tasks dropped below the expectations (Figure 1 ), most notably for the programming standards (from 3.0 to 2.0) and the desire to use AI (from 4.5 to 3.75). The developers were neutral regarding the helpfulness of the agent for solving the tasks (mean 3.0). In the free-text answers, the developers found the agent helpful for typing, documentation, and finding logic errors. As problems, they named that the agent is not user-friendly and new to them (2 mentions each), that it does not know the ABB documentation, and that it has no access to RobotStudio. The usability problems mainly refer to the terminal interface of Claude Code: the developers usually work with graphical tools like RobotStudio and reported that working in the terminal was new and unfriendly for them. Thus, the first focus day lowered the expectations of the developers, but did not lead to a rejection of the agent.

paragraphs.en: The chat histories and our observations during the focus day explain, at least partially, why the agent did not help. The developers did not invoke any of the three skills we prepared (with one single exception from D3 on Task 4), and they did not provide the agent with reference code from the project to explain the task or the given code. Instead, the developers used the agent for every change, even for trivial ones like adding or removing a comma. As a consequence, the agent regenerated large parts of the code, sometimes whole modules, again and again. The conversations became very long, and towards their end, the agent started to hallucinate and drifted away from correct intermediate solutions. We observed that the first answers of the agent were often a good starting point. However, the repeated regeneration for small changes negated the time saved through these first answers. Table I shows the number of prompts per task for each developer. We can see that the developers needed fewer prompts for Task 2 and 3 where the developers asked the agent to scan and fill information or fix the code, whereas they interacted more with the agent for the tasks that required multiple actions and adjustments, like Task 6.
paragraphs.zh: 聊天记录以及我们在重点观察日的观察，至少部分地解释了为什么智能体没有起到帮助作用。 开发者没有调用我们准备的三个技能中的任何一个（只有 D3 在任务 4 中出现过一次例外），他们也没有向智能体提供项目中的参考代码来解释任务或给定代码。 相反，开发者把每次修改都交给智能体处理，即使是添加或删除一个逗号这样的琐碎修改也不例外。 结果，智能体一次又一次地重新生成代码的很大部分，有时甚至是整个模块。 对话变得非常长，在对话接近尾声时，智能体开始产生幻觉，并偏离了正确的中间解决方案。 我们观察到，智能体的首次回答通常是一个很好的起点。 然而，为小改动而反复重新生成，抵消了这些首次回答所节省的时间。 表 I 展示了每位开发者在每个任务中的提示数量。 我们可以看到，对于任务 2 和任务 3，开发者需要较少的提示，因为这些任务中开发者只是让智能体扫描并填写信息或修复代码；而对于需要多次操作和调整的任务（如任务 6），开发者与智能体的交互则更多。

paragraphs.en: On the second focus day, the completion rate with the agent did not improve (Table I ). With the agent, the developers finished only 1 of 9 tasks within the time limit, i.e., D2 the trajectory matrix generation (Task 5). Without AI, they finished 5 of 9 tasks. The solution of D2 for Task 5 took 15 minutes, which is less than the 18 minutes D2 required for the same type of task without AI on the first focus day. This is also as fast as D1, the most experienced robotic engineer, without AI on the second focus day. Otherwise, the developers with the agent again required at least as much time as the developers without AI. For example, D1 hit the time limit of Task 1 with the agent, while D2 and D4 finished the same task without AI after 18 and 33 minutes. Nobody finished the documentation task (Task 2) or the 3D stacking task (Task 6).

paragraphs.en: The assessment by the team lead is more mixed than on the first focus day. For Task 5, both solutions with the agent met the expectations for functionality and code quality, while the solution without AI only partially met the functionality criterion. For Task 2, the solutions with and without the agent partially met the functionality criterion. However, for Tasks 1, 4, and 6, the functionality of all solutions with the agent did not meet the criterion, while the solutions without AI met the expectations (Task 1) or partially met them (Tasks 4 and 6). On average over all tasks, the functionality with the agent is 1.8 (without AI 2.3), the code quality 2.0 (2.3), and the readability 2.4 (2.7). Thus, the gap to the solutions without AI became smaller for code quality and readability, while the gap for functionality mostly remains.

Moreover, six wrong movements in Task 4 occur in all three solutions, with and without the agent. sents.en: On average, the developers were neutral (means 3.3 and 3.4 over 15 answers), but the answers range from 1 to 5.

paragraphs.en: As examples for avoided problems, the developers named faster results, fewer errors during monotonous typing, more professional wording of the documentation, and checking the numbering of positions. As new problems, they named hallucinations, wrong renamings, syntax errors, the need to write exact prompts, that sorting routines was impossible, and that the agent only sees the code, but not the real conditions of the robot cell. Thus, the developers see both benefits and drawbacks of the agent, which depend on the task.

paragraphs.en: After the second focus day, the agreement that the agent understands the tasks correctly (2.0), and the agreement with better results (1.67) and adherence to the programming standards (1.67) all dropped (Figure 1 ). In contrast, the desire to use AI (4.33) and the expected speed-up (3.33) increased slightly in comparison to the first focus day. However, this comparison is affected by the absence of D3, who had the lowest agreement after the first focus day. For D1, D2, and D4 only, the desire to use AI increased from 4.0 to 4.33 and the agreement that the agent was helpful from 3.0 to 3.33, while the expected speed-up decreased from 3.67 to 3.33. In the free-text answers, the developers described the agent as helpful for searching information, documentation, and rewriting routines. They named server problems and explaining the task to the agent as problems. Nobody named the usability of the agent or the missing ABB documentation as a problem anymore. Thus, the developers became more critical regarding the quality of the results, while their desire to use the agent remained high.

paragraphs.en: We observed that the developers were more interested in the agent than on the first focus day and asked about commands and skills. We can see for Tasks 4 and 5 where the reversing skill is automatically activated, they required fewer prompts than on first focus day as shown in Table I . However, the chat histories show that the developers still used the agent for every change, including trivial ones, which again led to long conversations in which the agent drifted away from correct intermediate solutions. Thus, the re-design of the agent addressed the missing domain knowledge, but not this usage pattern.
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，开发者对智能体的兴趣比第一个聚焦日更高，并询问了命令与技能相关的问题。 可以看到，在任务 4 和任务 5 中，逆向技能会被自动激活，如表 I 所示，它们所需的提示比第一个聚焦日更少。 然而，聊天记录显示，开发者仍然对每一次修改都使用智能体，包括琐碎的修改，这再次导致了漫长的对话，使智能体偏离了正确的中间解决方案。 因此，智能体的重新设计解决了领域知识缺失的问题，但没有解决这种使用模式的问题。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the comparison of the two focus days shows only a partial improvement for the agent. The completion rate with the agent did not improve, i.e., 3 of 12 tasks on the first and 1 of 9 tasks on the second focus day, while the completion rate without AI was similar on both focus days (9 of 12 and 5 of 9). The functionality of the solutions with the agent did not improve. However, the code quality (from 0.8 to 1.0), the readability (from 1.0 to 1.4), and the adherence to the programming standards according to the validator improved, i.e., 16 instead of 25 violations and 5 of 8 instead of 2 of 10 solutions without violations. We believe that the better adherence to the programming standards due to the reference manual in the project context of the re-designed agent.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，两个焦点日的对比显示智能体仅有部分改进。 使用智能体的完成率并未提高，即第一个焦点日12个任务中的3个、第二个焦点日9个任务中的1个，而未使用AI时两个焦点日的完成率相近（12个中的9个和9个中的5个）。 使用智能体的解决方案的功能性没有提高。 然而，代码质量（从0.8提升到1.0）、可读性（从1.0提升到1.4）以及依据校验器衡量的对编程规范的遵循程度有所提高，即违规从25处降至16处，无违规解决方案从10个中的2个提升到8个中的5个。 我们认为，得益于项目上下文中的参考手册，重新设计的智能体更好地遵循了编程规范。

paragraphs.en: The trajectory matrix generation (Task 5) is the only task for which the agent led to the same or better results than without AI on both focus days. On the second focus day, D2 even finished this task faster with the agent than without AI on the first focus day. Moreover, the problems with the agent shifted from errors of the agent and the usage of the agent to explaining the task to the agent, while the developers reported the same problems without AI on both focus days. However, the perceived difficulty with the agent did not decrease: the developers perceived four of six tasks as harder with the agent on the second focus day than on the first focus day, and only the path inversion (Task 4) as easier.

paragraphs.en: Regarding the experience of the developers, the only task completed with the agent on the second focus day was completed by D2, the developer with the most AI experience. In contrast, D1, the most experienced robotic engineer, did not finish any task with the agent on the second focus day, and D4, who rarely or never uses AI, did not finish any task with the agent on either focus day. Without AI, all developers finished tasks on both focus days. The post-questionnaires show a similar pattern. While the mean agreement with the statements decreased in comparison to the expectations, the individual developers differ. D4 is the only developer whose agreement decreased for all five statements after the first focus day and did not recover after the second focus day. In contrast, D1 and D2 each rated at least one statement higher after the first focus day than before, e.g., D1 agreed more that their results are better with the agent (from 2 to 3) and D2 agreed more that the agent speeds up the development (from 4 to 5). Thus, the developer with the least AI experience was also the one who was disappointed by the agent the most. This indicates that the experience with AI matters at least as much as the robotics experience for the successful use of the agent.

paragraphs.en: Overall, our results show that the agent did not help the developers to complete more tasks, to complete them faster, or to create solutions with better functionality. This is not what we expected, because our prior work showed that an LLM can perform key steps of these tasks [ 10 ] and related literature also indicated positive findings in other settings [ 9 , 16 ] . The likely cause is the difference between the clean, benchmark-like setting of our prior work and the real-world setting with developers who have different expectations and levels of experience with AI agents.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果表明，该智能体并没有帮助开发者完成更多任务、更快地完成任务，或创建功能更好的解决方案。 这与我们的预期不符，因为我们之前的工作表明大语言模型能够执行这些任务的关键步骤 [ 10 ]，并且相关文献在其他场景中也显示了积极的结果 [ 9 , 16 ]。 可能的原因在于我们之前工作中干净、类似基准测试的设置与现实世界设置之间的差异，后者中的开发者对 AI 智能体有着不同的期望和不同的使用经验水平。

paragraphs.en: Notably, the agent performed worst where we expected it to perform best: for Tasks 1, 4, and 6, i.e., the tasks that are closest to our prior work. We see two potential interpretations. First, the capability of an LLM to perform small, isolated changes does not transfer to larger tasks in realistic settings, in which many such changes must be planned and combined within an existing project. Second, even if the agent can be used for such tasks, this does not mean that it is more efficient than experienced developers. However, neither interpretation implies that the agent cannot perform better in these settings. Our results also show that the inexperience of the developers with agents was a major factor (Section V-B ) and that the gap to the solutions without AI became smaller for code quality and readability between the focus days, even though the gap for functionality mostly remained.
paragraphs.zh: 值得注意的是，该智能体在我们预期其表现最好的地方表现最差：对于任务 1、4 和 6，即与我们先前工作最接近的任务。 我们看到两种可能的解释。 首先，大语言模型执行小的、孤立改动的能力，并不能迁移到现实场景中更大的任务上，因为在这些任务中，需要在现有项目内规划并组合许多这样的改动。 其次，即使该智能体能够用于此类任务，也不意味着它比经验丰富的开发者更高效。 然而，这两种解释都不意味着该智能体在这些场景下无法表现得更好。 我们的结果还表明，开发者缺乏使用智能体的经验是一个主要因素（第 V-B 节），并且在专注日之间，与不使用 AI 的方案在代码质量和可读性上的差距有所缩小，尽管在功能性上的差距大多仍然存在。

sents.en: Notably, the agent performed worst where we expected it to perform best: for Tasks 1, 4, and 6, i.e., the tasks that are closest to our prior work.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，该智能体在我们预期其表现最好的地方表现最差：对于任务 1、4 和 6，即与我们先前工作最接近的任务。

sents.zh: 我们看到两种可能的解释。

sents.en: First, the capability of an LLM to perform small, isolated changes does not transfer to larger tasks in realistic settings, in which many such changes must be planned and combined within an existing project.
sents.zh: 首先，大语言模型执行小的、孤立改动的能力，并不能迁移到现实场景中更大的任务上，因为在这些任务中，需要在现有项目内规划并组合许多这样的改动。

sents.en: Second, even if the agent can be used for such tasks, this does not mean that it is more efficient than experienced developers.
sents.zh: 其次，即使该智能体能够用于此类任务，也不意味着它比经验丰富的开发者更高效。

sents.en: However, neither interpretation implies that the agent cannot perform better in these settings.
sents.zh: 然而，这两种解释都不意味着该智能体在这些场景下无法表现得更好。

sents.zh: 我们的结果还表明，开发者缺乏使用智能体的经验是一个主要因素（第 V-B 节），并且在专注日之间，与不使用 AI 的方案在代码质量和可读性上的差距有所缩小，尽管在功能性上的差距大多仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: Consequently, we expect that the productivity with agents is not fixed, but shifts over time with training and experience. Our two focus days only provide two snapshots of this development. Thus, longitudinal studies are needed to understand how the productivity evolves and how developers can best be supported during this transition.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们预期使用智能体的生产力并非固定不变，而是会随着培训与经验的积累随时间推移而变化。 我们的两天专注观察日只能提供这一发展过程中的两个快照。 因此，需要进行纵向研究，以了解生产力如何演变，以及在这一转型期间如何才能最好地支持开发者。

paragraphs.en: Still, we observed positive aspects of the agent. On the second focus day, the solutions with the agent adhered better to AKE’s programming standards, i.e., 5 of 8 solutions were free of violations in comparison to 2 of 10 on the first focus day. Since this is (at least partially) also caused by our re-configuration of the agent, this shows that the learning curve does not only concern the developers. Thus, context-specific configurations are an important factor that must be carefully considered and controlled when assessing the performance of agents in real-world settings.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，我们仍观察到智能体的积极方面。 在第二个聚焦日，使用智能体的解决方案更好地遵守了 AKE 的编程规范，即 8 个解决方案中有 5 个没有违规，而第一个聚焦日 10 个解决方案中只有 2 个没有违规。 由于这（至少部分地）也是由我们对智能体的重新配置引起的，这表明学习曲线不仅涉及开发人员。 因此，特定于上下文的配置是一个重要因素，在评估智能体在真实环境中的表现时必须仔细考虑和控制这一因素。

sents.zh: 由于这（至少部分地）也是由我们对智能体的重新配置引起的，这表明学习曲线不仅涉及开发人员。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, the developers appreciated on both focus days that the agent reduced repetitive work, e.g., monotonous typing. This is also reflected by the trajectory matrix generation (Task 5), the only task for which the agent led to the same or better results than working without AI on both focus days. Once the task is well understood and the trajectories are known to the developers, the agent effectively supports the implementation of highly repetitive code. This indicates that the agent is most useful when the developers can precisely specify what they want and the remaining work is mostly the writing of code.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，开发者在两个重点日都认可智能体减少了重复性工作，例如单调的输入操作。 这也体现在轨迹矩阵生成（任务5）上，这是唯一一个在两个重点日中智能体都带来了相同或优于不使用 AI 的工作效果的任务。 一旦任务被充分理解且开发者已了解各条轨迹，智能体就能有效支持高度重复代码的实现。 这表明，当开发者能够精确说明他们的需求且剩余工作主要是编写代码时，智能体最为有用。

sents.en: Moreover, the developers appreciated on both focus days that the agent reduced repetitive work, e.g., monotonous typing.
sents.zh: 此外，开发者在两个重点日都认可智能体减少了重复性工作，例如单调的输入操作。

sents.en: This is also reflected by the trajectory matrix generation (Task 5), the only task for which the agent led to the same or better results than working without AI on both focus days.
sents.zh: 这也体现在轨迹矩阵生成（任务5）上，这是唯一一个在两个重点日中智能体都带来了相同或优于不使用 AI 的工作效果的任务。

sents.en: Once the task is well understood and the trajectories are known to the developers, the agent effectively supports the implementation of highly repetitive code.
sents.zh: 一旦任务被充分理解且开发者已了解各条轨迹，智能体就能有效支持高度重复代码的实现。

sents.en: This indicates that the agent is most useful when the developers can precisely specify what they want and the remaining work is mostly the writing of code.
sents.zh: 这表明，当开发者能够精确说明他们的需求且剩余工作主要是编写代码时，智能体最为有用。

paragraphs.en: Our results indicate that the main problem was not only the capability of the model, but also how the developers used the agent. Experienced robotic engineers are not automatically experienced users of agents. Moreover, robotic development relies on visual tools and differs from the mostly text-based programming in other areas of software engineering, for which agents like Claude Code are designed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果表明，主要问题不仅在于模型的能力，还在于开发者如何使用智能体。 经验丰富的机器人工程师并不自动就是经验丰富的智能体用户。 此外，机器人开发依赖于可视化工具，这不同于软件工程其他领域中大多以文本为主的编程方式，而像 Claude Code 这样的智能体正是为此类编程方式设计的。

sents.en: Our results indicate that the main problem was not only the capability of the model, but also how the developers used the agent.
sents.zh: 我们的结果表明，主要问题不仅在于模型的能力，还在于开发者如何使用智能体。

sents.en: Experienced robotic engineers are not automatically experienced users of agents.
sents.zh: 经验丰富的机器人工程师并不自动就是经验丰富的智能体用户。

sents.en: Moreover, robotic development relies on visual tools and differs from the mostly text-based programming in other areas of software engineering, for which agents like Claude Code are designed.
sents.zh: 此外，机器人开发依赖于可视化工具，这不同于软件工程其他领域中大多以文本为主的编程方式，而像 Claude Code 这样的智能体正是为此类编程方式设计的。

paragraphs.en: First, the developers overused the agent. Instead of using it as an assistant, they delegated all work to it, including trivial changes such as adding a comma. This is not only inefficient, but also leads to long conversations, in which the agent drifted away from correct intermediate solutions. This is in line with the known degradation of LLMs for long contexts [ 14 ] . We observed this usage pattern on both focus days, i.e., the re-design of the agent did not address it.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，开发者过度使用了智能体。 他们没有把它当作助手使用，而是把所有工作都委托给它，包括添加逗号这类琐碎的修改。 这不仅效率低下，还会导致冗长的对话，智能体在其中逐渐偏离了正确的中间方案。 这与已知的 LLM 在长上下文中的性能退化现象相符 [ 14 ] 。 我们在两个重点观察日都观察到了这种使用模式，即对智能体的重新设计并未解决该问题。

sents.en: First, the developers overused the agent.
sents.zh: 首先，开发者过度使用了智能体。

sents.en: Instead of using it as an assistant, they delegated all work to it, including trivial changes such as adding a comma.
sents.zh: 他们没有把它当作助手使用，而是把所有工作都委托给它，包括添加逗号这类琐碎的修改。

sents.en: This is not only inefficient, but also leads to long conversations, in which the agent drifted away from correct intermediate solutions.
sents.zh: 这不仅效率低下，还会导致冗长的对话，智能体在其中逐渐偏离了正确的中间方案。

sents.zh: 这与已知的 LLM 在长上下文中的性能退化现象相符 [ 14 ] 。

sents.zh: 我们在两个重点观察日都观察到了这种使用模式，即对智能体的重新设计并未解决该问题。

paragraphs.en: Second, the developers were used to chat-based AI systems and used the agent in the same manner, even though the introduction explained how to invoke the skills. As a consequence, the developers ignored the skills we prepared, with a single exception, which contributed to the problems on the first focus day. This shows that the design of an agent must fit the expectations and habits of its users. Our re-design for the second focus day follows this idea: instead of requiring the developers to invoke skills, the agent uses the domain knowledge from the project context automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，开发者们习惯了基于对话的 AI 系统，并以同样的方式使用该智能体，尽管介绍中已经说明了如何调用技能。 结果，开发者们忽略了我们准备的技能，仅有一个例外，这在第一个专注日的问题中起了推波助澜的作用。 这表明智能体的设计必须符合其用户的期望与习惯。 我们针对第二个专注日的重新设计正是遵循了这一理念：不再要求开发者调用技能，而是让智能体自动使用来自项目上下文的领域知识。

sents.en: Second, the developers were used to chat-based AI systems and used the agent in the same manner, even though the introduction explained how to invoke the skills.
sents.zh: 其次，开发者们习惯了基于对话的 AI 系统，并以同样的方式使用该智能体，尽管介绍中已经说明了如何调用技能。

sents.en: Our re-design for the second focus day follows this idea: instead of requiring the developers to invoke skills, the agent uses the domain knowledge from the project context automatically.
sents.zh: 我们针对第二个专注日的重新设计正是遵循了这一理念：不再要求开发者调用技能，而是让智能体自动使用来自项目上下文的领域知识。

paragraphs.en: Third, robotic engineering relies on visually observing how the robot moves in the simulated cell. Our agent only had access to the code, but not to the virtual station, which the developers also named as a problem. We believe that the resulting lack of spatial understanding contributes to the poor functionality of the generated code. A deeper integration of the agent with RobotStudio, e.g., through suitable MCP servers [ 2 ] , could help to overcome this limitation.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，机器人工程依赖于直观观察机器人在仿真单元中的运动方式。 我们的智能体只能访问代码，而无法访问虚拟工作站，开发者也指出这是一个问题。 我们认为，由此导致的空间理解缺失是生成代码功能不佳的原因之一。 将智能体与 RobotStudio 进行更深度的集成，例如通过合适的 MCP 服务器 [ 2 ]，可能有助于克服这一局限。

sents.en: Third, robotic engineering relies on visually observing how the robot moves in the simulated cell.
sents.zh: 第三，机器人工程依赖于直观观察机器人在仿真单元中的运动方式。

sents.zh: 我们的智能体只能访问代码，而无法访问虚拟工作站，开发者也指出这是一个问题。

sents.en: A deeper integration of the agent with RobotStudio, e.g., through suitable MCP servers [ 2 ] , could help to overcome this limitation.
sents.zh: 将智能体与 RobotStudio 进行更深度的集成，例如通过合适的 MCP 服务器 [ 2 ]，可能有助于克服这一局限。

paragraphs.en: Fourth, we underestimated the impact of the terminal interface. While working in a terminal is common in software development, robotic engineers mostly work with graphical tools like RobotStudio and perceived the terminal as new and unfriendly on the first focus day. However, nobody named the usability as a problem after the second focus day, i.e., the developers quickly overcame this hurdle. Experiments with a high degree of control over a short period of time ignore such learning effects, even though they are an important confounding factor.
paragraphs.zh: 第四，我们低估了终端界面的影响。 虽然在终端中工作是软件开发中的常见做法，但机器人工程师大多使用 RobotStudio 等图形化工具，在第一个焦点日，他们觉得终端既陌生又不友好。 然而，在第二个焦点日之后，没有人再把可用性当作问题，也就是说，开发者很快克服了这个障碍。 在短时间内进行高度受控的实验会忽略这类学习效应，尽管学习效应是一个重要的混淆因素。

sents.en: Fourth, we underestimated the impact of the terminal interface.
sents.zh: 第四，我们低估了终端界面的影响。

sents.zh: 在短时间内进行高度受控的实验会忽略这类学习效应，尽管学习效应是一个重要的混淆因素。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we note that the agent acted, to some degree, as an equalizer between the developers: the experience with robotic engineering did not determine the success with the agent, but the experience with AI did, i.e., something that is relatively new to all developers. The only task finished with the agent on the second focus day was solved by D2, who has the most AI experience, while D4, who rarely or never uses AI, did not finish any task with the agent and was the most disappointed by it. However, all developers in our case study are senior engineers with at least seven years of experience. Thus, we cannot generalize this observation to less experienced developers.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们注意到智能体在某种程度上起到了开发者之间均衡器的作用：机器人工程方面的经验并不能决定使用智能体的成败，而AI方面的经验却可以，也就是说，这一点对所有开发者来说都是相对较新的。 第二个专注日上唯一用智能体完成的任务是由AI经验最丰富的D2解决的，而很少或从不使用AI的D4没有用智能体完成任何任务，并且是其中最感到失望的。 然而，我们案例研究中的所有开发者都是拥有至少七年经验的高级工程师。 因此，我们无法将这一观察结果推广到经验较少的开发者。

paragraphs.en: An on-premise agent with an open-weight model is technically feasible for SMEs. However, it is not a plug-and-play solution that directly increases productivity. Based on our case study, we recommend the following to SMEs that consider adopting agents for robotic engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 对于中小企业而言，在本地部署环境中使用开放权重模型的智能体在技术上是可行的。 然而，它并不是一种能够直接提升生产力的即插即用解决方案。 基于我们的案例研究，我们向考虑采用智能体进行机器人工程的中小企业提出以下建议。

sents.en: An on-premise agent with an open-weight model is technically feasible for SMEs.
sents.zh: 对于中小企业而言，在本地部署环境中使用开放权重模型的智能体在技术上是可行的。

sents.en: However, it is not a plug-and-play solution that directly increases productivity.
sents.zh: 然而，它并不是一种能够直接提升生产力的即插即用解决方案。

sents.en: Based on our case study, we recommend the following to SMEs that consider adopting agents for robotic engineering.
sents.zh: 基于我们的案例研究，我们向考虑采用智能体进行机器人工程的中小企业提出以下建议。

paragraphs.en: Train the usage, not only the tool. Developers need to learn when to use the agent, when to change code manually, and when to start a new conversation. In our case, a short introduction to the tool was not sufficient. Instead, SMEs should plan dedicated training sessions with exercises in which the developers learn how to use the agent effectively, as well as time for the developers to get used to the agent in their daily work.
paragraphs.zh: 培训使用方法，而不仅仅是培训工具。 开发者需要学习何时使用智能体，何时手动修改代码，以及何时开启新的对话。 在我们的案例中，对工具的简短介绍是不够的。 相反，中小企业（SME）应安排专门的培训课程，通过练习让开发者学会如何有效使用智能体，并为开发者留出在日常工作中熟悉智能体的时间。

sents.en: Train the usage, not only the tool.
sents.zh: 培训使用方法，而不仅仅是培训工具。

sents.en: Developers need to learn when to use the agent, when to change code manually, and when to start a new conversation.
sents.zh: 开发者需要学习何时使用智能体，何时手动修改代码，以及何时开启新的对话。

sents.en: In our case, a short introduction to the tool was not sufficient.

sents.en: Instead, SMEs should plan dedicated training sessions with exercises in which the developers learn how to use the agent effectively, as well as time for the developers to get used to the agent in their daily work.
sents.zh: 相反，中小企业（SME）应安排专门的培训课程，通过练习让开发者学会如何有效使用智能体，并为开发者留出在日常工作中熟悉智能体的时间。

paragraphs.en: Start with suitable tasks. Repetitive and well-specified generation tasks, e.g., trajectory matrices or drafts of documentation, are a better starting point than tasks that require a spatial understanding of the robot cell. This way, the developers can gain experience with the agent on tasks for which it already provides a benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 从合适的任务开始。 重复性强且定义明确的生成类任务，例如轨迹矩阵或文档草稿，比那些需要对机器人单元进行空间理解的任务更适合作为起点。 这样，开发人员就可以通过智能体已经能带来收益的任务来积累使用经验。

paragraphs.en: Our case study also raises questions for research on agents in robotic engineering and, more generally, in specialized engineering domains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的案例研究也为机器人工程领域，以及更广泛地说，在专业化工程领域中有关智能体的研究提出了问题。

paragraphs.en: Evaluate with developers in the loop. Benchmarks on isolated tasks do not capture how developers actually use agents. Our results demonstrate this: while our prior work showed that an LLM can perform key steps of the tasks [ 10 ] , the developers did not benefit from this with the agent. Thus, researchers should complement benchmarks with studies of real tasks in real contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 让开发者在环中进行评估。 针对孤立任务的基准测试无法反映开发者在实际中如何使用智能体。 我们的结果证明了这一点：尽管我们先前的工作表明大语言模型能够完成这些任务的关键步骤 [10]，但开发者并未从该智能体中受益。 因此，研究者应当以真实情境下真实任务的研究来补充基准测试。

paragraphs.en: Study adoption over time. Our two focus days provide only two snapshots, but already show strong learning effects, e.g., regarding the terminal interface. paragraphs.zh: 研究随时间推移的采用情况。 我们的两次焦点日只能提供两个快照，但已经显示出强烈的学习效应，例如在终端界面方面。 纵向研究可以揭示学习曲线有多长，使用模式是否随着经验增加而改变，以及生产力最终是否会超过不使用AI时的生产力。

paragraphs.en: Report the configuration of agents. Our results show that seemingly small differences in the configuration, i.e., skills that developers invoke vs. a project context that the agent uses automatically, can affect the outcomes. Thus, researchers should report such details to allow for comparisons between studies.
paragraphs.zh: 报告智能体的配置。 我们的结果表明，配置中看似微小的差异（即开发者调用的技能 vs. 智能体自动使用的项目上下文）可能会影响结果。 因此，研究者应报告此类细节，以便在不同研究之间进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The main threat to the validity of our work is the small sample. Our results are based on four developers on the first and three on the second focus day, one company, one agent, and one model. Thus, our results do not generalize statistically. We mitigate this through a case study design that collects rich quantitative and qualitative data in a real industrial context [ 22 ] . Still, other models, agents, or companies may lead to different results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们工作有效性的主要威胁是样本量较小。 我们的结果基于第一个专注日的四名开发者和第二个专注日的三名开发者、一家公司、一个智能体和一个模型。 因此，我们的结果无法进行统计上的泛化。 我们通过案例研究设计来缓解这一问题，该设计在真实的工业环境中收集了丰富的定量和定性数据 [ 22 ] 。 尽管如此，其他模型、智能体或公司可能会产生不同的结果。

paragraphs.en: The team lead was the only assessor and the assessment was not blind, i.e., the team lead knew which solutions were created with the agent. To mitigate this threat, we complement the assessment with the validator, which checks the adherence to the programming standards independently of the team lead. Moreover, the time limits mean that we cannot measure how long unfinished tasks would have taken.
paragraphs.zh: 团队主管是唯一的评估者，且评估并非盲评，即团队主管知道哪些解决方案是使用智能体创建的。 为了缓解这一威胁，我们用验证器来补充评估，验证器独立于团队主管检查是否遵循编程规范。 此外，由于存在时间限制，我们无法测量未完成的任务本需要多长时间才能完成。

paragraphs.en: While our design has aspects of a controlled experiment, it is not a controlled experiment, because of both the sample size and the changes we applied between the focus days, like the re-design of the agent. paragraphs.en: We report a case study with AKE Technologies, in which four experienced robotic engineers solved six tasks from real projects with and without an on-premise AI agent on two focus days. Our results show that the agent did not make the developers more productive: with the agent, they finished only 4 of 21 tasks within the time limit, in comparison to 14 of 21 without AI, and the functionality of their solutions was worse. The only exception is the generation of highly repetitive code. However, the solutions with the agent improved between the focus days, e.g., 5 of 8 instead of 2 of 10 solutions adhered to AKE’s programming standards. We believe that this is due to both the re-design of the agent and the learning curve of the developers, whose success with the agent depended more on their experience with AI than on their experience with robotic engineering. Thus, agents are not a plug-and-play solution for robotic engineering in SMEs: they require training, a configuration that fits the domain, and time. In future work, we want to study how the productivity evolves over longer periods of time and whether a deeper integration of the agent with RobotStudio, i.e., access to the virtual station, overcomes the missing spatial understanding of the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了一项与 AKE Technologies 合作的案例研究：在两个重点工作日中，四名经验丰富的机器人工程师在使用和不使用本地部署智能体的情况下，完成了来自真实项目的六项任务。 我们的结果表明，智能体并未提升开发者的生产力：使用智能体时，他们在时限内仅完成了 21 项任务中的 4 项，而不使用 AI 时完成了 21 项中的 14 项，且其解决方案的功能性更差。 唯一的例外是高度重复性代码的生成。 然而，使用智能体的解决方案在两个重点日之间有所改进，例如，遵守 AKE 编程规范的解决方案从 10 个中的 2 个提升到 8 个中的 5 个。 我们认为，这既是由于智能体的重新设计，也是由于开发者的学习曲线：开发者使用智能体的成败更多取决于其使用 AI 的经验，而非其机器人工程经验。 因此，智能体对中小企业（SME）的机器人工程而言并非即插即用的解决方案：它们需要培训、符合领域的配置以及时间。 在未来的工作中，我们希望研究生产力在更长时间内如何演变，以及智能体与 RobotStudio 的更深层次集成（即访问虚拟工作站）能否弥补智能体所缺失的空间理解能力。
